scope: Exact municipal feature semantic lookup and bounded primary-source research; no production geometry changes

source.dataset: 京都市 3D都市モデル LOD1_2025
source.reader: GDAL ogrinfo 3.10.3; read-only attribute query, geometry omitted

schemaReview.classMeaning: Ordinary wall-less structure; the category also covers specified greenhouse/industrial structures below three storeys.
schemaReview.heightMethodMeaning: Point-cloud median used for the LOD1 extrusion.
schemaReview.solidMeaning: LOD1 extrudes the upper orthographic outline upward from ground at one height; median is the stated principle.
schemaReview.measuredHeightMeaning: Lowest above-ground point to highest point, metres.
schemaReview.baseZInterpretation: 37.25 is the retained LOD1 model lower boundary. The schema describes a ground-up abstraction; this value does not establish a measured roof underside or platform clearance.
limits: The 2.9 m measured-height attribute and 2.124 m solid extent retain distinct meanings; their numerical discrepancy is not resolved by this lookup.
Exact roof thickness, support positions, openings, clearance and present condition remain unverified.

The semantic class supports an open-structure classification. Any authored open archetype must retain source identity, footprint and top extent while declaring post layout, roof thickness and clearance as authored.

facts: Shijo sidewalk widening between Karasuma and Kawabata completed at the end of October 2015.
The project describes a 1120 m section, 22 m wide.
Sixteen bus stops were consolidated into four Shijo Takakura/Shijo Kawaramachi eastbound and westbound locations with roadway-projecting terrace stops.
projectReview.limits: Project-level evidence does not specify this feature's roof/support geometry; no permission to redistribute official imagery is inferred.
